subject: general
question:
The number of sport bicycles sold by a shopkeeper in five years is shown in the following bar graph. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bce5481ec584b62662263cc971ffbeee96432a9c23a38b13696c4e4bcd3ba455.png] 

What is the percentage of decrease in the sale of sport bicycles in the year 2021 over that in the previous year?
solution:
**Calculation:**

The sale of sports bicycles in 2020 = 200

The sale of sports bicycles in 2021 = 145

Percent decrement in sales of sports bicycles = {(200 - 145) × 100}/200

⇒ 55/2 = 27.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 27.5%.**
